name: slope
description: SLOPE sprint tracking, guard hooks, and Codex workflow skills.

interface.shortDescription: Sprint tracking, guard hooks, and workflow skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Packages SLOPE's Codex-facing adapter boundary: guard hook metadata, a dispatcher over the SLOPE CLI, MCP server metadata, and skills for sprint setup, closeout, post-merge retros, and guard-warning handling. Runtime guard execution uses user or project hooks.json shims until Codex plugin_hooks is stable.
defaultPrompt: Set up SLOPE for this repo from Codex.
Start or inspect the current SLOPE sprint.
Close out the sprint with validation and review.
Run a post-merge retro and save durable learnings.
